MSDOS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install msdos. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

MSDOS_VERSION.description: Specific version of msdos to install.

MSDOS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading msdos binary or archive artifacts.

MSDOS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying msdos available remote releases.

MSDOS_BUILD_MODE.description: Kernel synthesis mode: from-source (NASM clean-room IO.SYS + kvikdos/scp2nasm) or repack.

MSDOS_CPU_FLAVOR.description: Guest CPU target flavor (8086 for 1.25/2.0 real mode or 386 for 4.00 with DPMI).

MSDOS_SERIAL_COM1.description: Configure clean-room IO.SYS AUX/CON hooks and boot scripts for COM1 serial telemetry when set to 1.

MSDOS_ASSEMBLER_BACKEND.description: Assembler backend for clean-room BIOS/boot modules and lowered sources (nasm, jwasm, fasm, or kvikdos).
